notes.note: Reviewed the media-tools home-root classification against the archive/rollback owner. Unknown roots already use the conservative state behavior; the explicit media-tools state entry preserves backup and rollback rather than introducing an external/live exclusion. The complete focused run exposed the missing inventory entry. Registry regression and removal mutation passed; the real update-backup test restores model bytes after trial replacement and fails if the root is changed to external. Existing backup exclusions, restore/schema limits and historical ADR decisions remain accurate; no prose update or release qualification is implied.
